data.one_liner: Persona Inquiry for Flutter integrates native v2 SDKs for iOS and Android identity verification.
data.what_it_does: Integrates Persona Inquiry flows for identity verification into Flutter applications. It wraps the native v2 SDKs for iOS and Android, allowing developers to start inquiries, handle completion, cancellation, and errors, and listen to event streams.
use_when: You need to implement identity verification (KYC/AML) using Persona in a Flutter app.
Your app requires native Persona v2 SDK integration for iOS and Android.
avoid_when: You need a custom non-Persona verification flow built entirely in Flutter widgets.
You are using legacy Persona v1 integrations (requires version 2.1.5 or older branch instead).
strengths: Provides direct native v2 SDK wrappers for iOS and Android.
Includes stream-based event handling for completion, cancellation, and errors.
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of native requirements like JDK 17, minSdk changes, and camera/microphone permissions.
Client-side theming is deprecated by Persona.
data.setup_notes: Requires JDK 17+, AGP 8.9.1, Gradle 8.11.1, compileSdk 36, iOS 13.0+, minimum SDK 21 on Android, and adding permissions for camera, microphone, and location to Info.plist and AndroidManifest.xml.
